nodes.long_description:
# Train Like a Real Boxer

Boxing Drills VR brings authentic pad training to your Quest. No gym required.

**Realistic Drills**

Follow a virtual trainer through classic boxing combinations:
- **1-2 (Jab-Cross)** - The fundamental combo
- **1-2-Duck** - Add defensive movement
- **1-2-3** - Jab, Cross, Hook
- **1-2-3-2** - Extended combinations
- **Uppercut combos** - Work those body shots
- **Growing Library** - A vast selection of drills with new content added regularly!

**Built for Performance**

We know every millisecond counts when you're in the pocket.
- Low-Latency Precision: Built from the ground up for high-performance tracking.
- Native Feel: Optimized to ensure smooth, responsive feedback that feels like hitting real pads.

**Get Scored**

Every session tracks your performance:
- **Power** - Hit those pads hard
- **Speed** - Quick reactions matter
- **Agility** - Duck and weave like a pro
- **Form** - Return to guard after every punch

**Train Your Way**
- Multiple drill durations (30s to 3 min)
- Choose the speed that suits you (slow, medium, fast, progressive, variable)
- Passthrough mode - train safely in your own space

**Perfect For**
- Beginners learning boxing basics
- Fitness enthusiasts wanting a fun workout
- Experienced boxers staying sharp

No experience needed. Just clear some space, put on your Quest, and start throwing punches.

**Shape the Future (Open Source)**

We believe the best training tools are built by the community. We are moving toward an open-source model so the community can help us shape the roadmap of the product.
nodes.short_description: Train like a boxer in VR. Follow realistic pad drills with jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Practice defense with duck-and-weave combos. Track your power, speed, and form after every session.

nodes.change_log:
### v0.6.0

**Scoring Overhaul**
- Power and speed now use per-punch-type velocity thresholds instead of one generic range — jabs are judged as jabs, crosses as crosses
- Speed based on punch velocity (m/s) instead of reaction time — footwork movement no longer penalizes your speed score
- Separate weight class scaling for speed vs power: lighter boxers have faster hands (higher speed bar), bigger boxers generate more force (higher power bar)
- Agility replaces depth bonus with reaction speed — how quickly you dodge after the threat appears (<=0.3s = full credit, >=1.0s = zero)
- Body engagement excludes jabs — they're lead-hand snaps where body rotation isn't expected
- Body engagement display on complete screen only counts non-jab punches

**Form Scoring**
- Form now measures two components equally: off-hand discipline (50%) and punching hand retraction speed (50%)
- Off-hand check: is your non-punching hand in guard at moment of impact?
- Retraction check: does your punching hand return to guard within 0.5s? Must reach chest level — letting it drop doesn't count
- Guard zone is stance-agnostic — both face-guard and body-guard stances accepted
- Removed height requirement from off-hand guard check so body-guard boxers aren't penalized

**New Drill**
- Added 3-7 (hook head to hook body) drill — the liver shot combo

**Menu Redesign**
- Tab-based layout with TRAIN / FIGHT / WORKOUT / SETTINGS tabs
- Category sub-tabs within Train (Punch Combos, Defense, Footwork)
- Three-level joystick navigation: tabs, sub-tabs, drills

**UI Improvements**
- PR indicators shown on workout transition screen between drill segments
- Scoring guide added to the complete screen
- Guide link promoted to prominent button on landing page
- Fixed joystick navigation getting stuck on non-Train tabs

### v0.5.0

**Numbered Pads**
- Punch numbers (1-8) now render directly on pad faces as dark embossed digits on red pads
- Bitmap number textures generated at startup (64x64, scaled 5x7 font)
- Replaced per-punch-type color-coding — all pads stay red for a cleaner, less distracting look
- Numbers update dynamically: active pad shows current punch, inactive pad previews the next

**Fight Mode**
- New persistent career system where real training performance builds fighter stats
- Per-punch-type stat tracking (jab, cross, hooks, uppercuts, body hooks, duck, slip) using rolling average of last 5 sessions
- 8 sequential AI opponents with unique styles (Glass Joe to The Champ)
- Round-by-round narrated battles testing specific punches, combos, and defensive actions
- PR indicators on complete screen: "NEW PR!" (gold), near-miss (cyan), first time (green)
- Fighter card UI with per-punch stat bars and opponent info
- Career progress (wins/losses/KOs) persists across sessions

**Punch Validation**
- Punch type validation checks velocity direction against expected punch direction (jab=forward, hook=lateral, uppercut=upward)
- Wrong punch type flashes pad magenta with "WRONG PUNCH!" HUD feedback
- Weak punch feedback: intentional touches below hit threshold flash pad orange with "TOO WEAK!" HUD text

### v0.4.0

**Workout Mode**
- New Workout mode that chains random drills back-to-back with brief transitions between them
- Configurable workout duration (5/10/15/30/45/60 minutes), speed, and drill category filters (Punch Combos, Defense, Footwork)
- Configurable max drill time per segment (30s to 2 minutes, default 60s) for controlling drill variety
- Random speed option that varies speed each segment
- BOUNCE drill weighted 3x higher in workout rotation for cardio conditioning
- Aggregate results screen at workout end showing total drills, hit rate, and points
- Pause + EXIT cancels workout cleanly
- Workout settings persist across sessions

**Bounce Drill (formerly Skip Rope)**
- Reworked SKIP ROPE into BOUNCE drill with relaxed detection and simplified mechanics
- Added directional per-beat feedback showing timing accuracy (Perfect/Good/Miss)

**UI Improvements**
- Moved settings to a modal popup, freeing up space for an expanded drill list
- WORKOUT and SETTINGS buttons displayed side by side at the bottom of the menu
- Fixed settings button being cut off at the bottom of the screen
- Fixed menu overflow and defense threat offset in footwork mode

**Footwork Mode**
- Added footwork mode for padwork drills — trainer shifts laterally, requiring the player to move and reposition

**Double-End Bag**
- New double-end bag drill with spring physics
- Tuned for realistic physics, snappier oscillation, and removed hit threshold for natural feel

**Bug Fixes**
- Fixed settings not persisting across new builds
